zh.summary: 設計能找到問題、保留進度並回到任務的錯誤處理，並以鍵盤、文字標籤與實際任務檢查可近用性。
objectives: 區分資料缺漏、程式失敗與結果過期的復原方式。
為欄位標籤、焦點、鍵盤與非顏色提示寫出待驗條件。
保留自動檢查、人工操作與真人易用性測試各自的證據範圍。

readingGuide.goal: 區分資料缺漏、程式失敗與結果過期的復原方式。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 先用四狀態草圖；有自己的本機原型或教師示範環境後，再用瀏覽器與鍵盤操作。未啟動原型不填實測結果。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 具有復原設計及如實區分草圖、鍵盤實測與待驗項目的 wireframe-notes.md。

sections.heading: 錯誤訊息要讓任務繼續
paragraphs: 錯誤復原要回答哪裡出錯、使用者現在能做什麼，以及先前工作是否還在。「發生錯誤」通常不夠；本課缺少文件類型時，應指出該欄、保留另外兩欄，讓使用者補填後重新檢查。
資料缺漏、程式失敗與結果過期需要不同回饋。缺漏要補資料；技術失敗要說明目前未完成並提供適當重試或求助方式；結果過期則要以目前輸入重新檢查。不能把三者都顯示成「請重新輸入全部資料」。

sections.heading: 像道路封閉時提供可用的繞行方式
paragraphs: 道路封閉標示若只寫「錯誤」，駕駛仍不知道去哪裡。清楚指出封閉路段、可走路線與返回主線的位置，才支援繼續行程。介面也需要具體回復動作，而不只是警示圖示。
同時，指示要能被不同方式感知與操作。只以紅色標出缺件，對無法辨識該顏色的人可能不足；只在滑鼠移上去才出現說明，也不一定能由鍵盤取得。這些都應在設計時先列入待驗條件。

sections.heading: 以文字把位置、原因與動作連起來
paragraphs: W3C 的表單通知指南建議提供清楚的成功與錯誤回饋，錯誤內容要能指出相關欄位並說明如何修正。若用錯誤摘要，可讓其中項目協助使用者到達欄位；欄位旁的提示也需與控制項在程式中建立關聯。
動態訊息還要讓輔助科技能得知適當更新，不能只依視覺插入一段紅字。實作時需依訊息急迫性與元件選擇合適通知方式，並測試避免重複或打斷；本章不以任意加上 ARIA 就宣稱通過。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜三種問題，三條復原路徑
blocks.description: 卡片是不同問題的對照，不是固定發生順序；訊息必須符合實際狀態。

items.title: 資料缺漏
items.body: 缺少文件類型，請補填後重新檢查；保留其他已填內容，沒有完整匯出。

items.title: 程式失敗
items.body: 本次檢查未完成；保留輸入，依實際原因提供可行重試或求助。

items.title: 結果過期
items.body: 輸入已修改，請重新檢查；撤銷舊完成狀態與舊報告出口。

sections.heading: 可近用要落在操作與程式關係
paragraphs: 可近用性關心不同能力與輔助方式的使用者能否感知、理解及操作內容。W3C 的鍵盤說明要求功能可透過鍵盤介面操作，並明列以移動路徑為必要輸入的例外；本課的填寫、檢查與匯出不屬自由手繪，應有鍵盤路徑。焦點也需可見，讓人知道下一次按鍵作用在哪裡。
標籤與欄位要有程式關聯，視覺上的靠近不能取代它；顏色可輔助強調，但錯誤、完成與必要欄位的意思不只靠色相。這些是不同檢查面向，不能只測 Tab 能走完就宣稱整頁符合 WCAG。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜把設計承諾寫成待驗條件
rows: 標籤
輸入後仍知道欄位用途，控制項有可辨識名稱
檢查實際 DOM／可近用名稱；草圖位置不能代替
鍵盤與焦點
不用滑鼠可填寫、檢查、修正及匯出，知道目前焦點
人工或瀏覽器操作；也要檢查能離開元件
錯誤與進度
缺漏指出欄位，已填值保留，補齊後可重查
重演缺件情境；不等於所有錯誤都已涵蓋
非顏色訊息
文字或其他線索能識別錯誤與完成
檢查不只依賴顏色，輔助科技另需核對語意
動態狀態
更新能被適當感知且不無故搶焦點
依實作測試通知與輔助科技；不可由截圖判定

sections.heading: 用可重演的任務檢查恢復能力
paragraphs: 在自己的本機原型或教師示範環境，先用鍵盤輸入申請編號與申請人代號，保留文件類型空白後啟動檢查。觀察錯誤是否指出欄位、已填值是否還在、能否到達並修正。補齊與重新檢查後，再修改欄位，確認舊完成狀態不能繼續使用。
本課提供的 Streamlit 參考程式可供練習，但這段文字本身不是該程式的完整無障礙驗收。若發現焦點不可見、訊息沒被感知或某動作無法完成，記錄瀏覽器、步驟與觀察；尚未實作原型時先完成草圖檢查，實際鍵盤與輔助科技保持待驗。

sections.heading: 分開可近用、易用與通過證據
paragraphs: 可近用與易用彼此相關，但不能互相取代。通過一組技術檢查仍可能讓使用者不懂欄位；一次同儕順利操作，也不證明所有使用者或輔助科技可用。自動檢查、人工操作與真人任務觀察要各自寫明範圍。
常見誤解是「補一個說明頁就解決錯誤」。若當前畫面沒有指出缺哪欄，使用者仍需自己猜。先讓必要回饋與復原方法在任務位置可得，再將額外說明作補充；將確認的行為接到 M05 規格與 M08 驗證。

blocks.heading: 復原與可近用觀察表
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 復原觀察（合成任務）
環境：填寫實際瀏覽器與版本；尚未執行則填待驗
路徑：缺件 → 補齊 → 重查 → 修改 → 再重查
輸入保留：觀察值，不填預期值當結果
欄位名稱／錯誤關聯：實際核對或待驗
鍵盤／焦點：可達、可操作、可離開、可見
狀態：文字能辨識，不只靠顏色
輔助科技與真人任務：未執行則填待驗
發現與下一步：記錄阻礙、修改假設與重測條件
界線：這份觀察不等於完整 WCAG 認證

exercise.environment: 先用四狀態草圖；有自己的本機原型或教師示範環境後，再用瀏覽器與鍵盤操作。未啟動原型不填實測結果。
steps: 在草圖上分別標記缺漏、技術失敗與結果過期的訊息、進度保留及回復動作。
若原型可用，將滑鼠放旁邊，以 Tab／Shift+Tab、文字輸入及適合元件的按鍵重演缺件修正；觀察焦點與可離開性。
將實際結果或待驗狀態寫入 wireframe-notes.md，另列輔助科技、真人任務與未覆蓋錯誤；選一項阻礙安排修改與重測。
exercise.expected: 具有復原設計及如實區分草圖、鍵盤實測與待驗項目的 wireframe-notes.md。
exercise.check: 三類問題有不同出口；不把缺少原型時的紙上檢查、單次鍵盤操作或截圖當完整可近用認證。
exercise.cleanup: 只用合成資料，保留環境與重演步驟；不公開非必要個資或未授權錄影。

en.summary: Design error handling that locates problems, preserves progress and returns users to their task, then check accessibility through keyboards, text labels and actual tasks.
objectives: Distinguish recovery for missing input, program failure and stale results.
Define pending checks for labels, focus, keyboard operation and non-color feedback.
Retain separate evidence scopes for automated checks, manual operation and actual participant usability tests.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish recovery for missing input, program failure and stale results.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Begin with four-state sketches. Use a browser and keyboard once your local prototype or a teacher demonstration is available; record no runtime results before starting it.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md with recovery design and honest distinctions among sketches, actual keyboard checks and pending items.

sections.heading: Make Error Feedback Support Continued Work
paragraphs: Recovery should explain what failed, what users can do and whether previous work remains. “An error occurred” is usually insufficient. For missing document type, identify that field, retain the other two and allow correction followed by rechecking.

Missing input, technical failure and stale results need different feedback. Omissions require data; failures require an honest unfinished state with suitable retry/help; stale results need current-input rechecking. Do not reduce all three to “re-enter everything.”

sections.heading: Provide a Usable Diversion Around a Closed Road
paragraphs: A closure sign saying only “error” gives drivers no route. Identifying the closure, alternative and return point helps them continue. An interface similarly needs specific recovery actions beyond a warning icon.

Guidance also needs different ways to perceive and operate it. Red-only missing-input feedback may be insufficient for someone who cannot distinguish that color. Hover-only explanations may be unavailable by keyboard. List such conditions for verification during design.

sections.heading: Connect Location, Cause and Action in Text
paragraphs: W3C’s forms notification guidance recommends clear success/error feedback identifying relevant fields and correction. An error summary can help users reach fields; nearby feedback also needs a programmatic relationship with controls.

Assistive technology must be able to receive appropriate dynamic updates, not just a newly inserted red paragraph. Choose notification mechanisms for urgency and component behavior, then test for duplication or interruption. Arbitrarily adding ARIA does not establish a pass.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Problems with Different Recovery Paths
blocks.description: The cards compare problems, not a fixed occurrence sequence. Messages must match actual state.

items.title: Missing information
items.body: Document type is missing. Retain other values, explain correction and rechecking, and offer no complete-report export.

items.title: Program failure
items.body: This check did not finish. Keep input and provide feasible retry or help based on the actual cause.

items.title: Stale results
items.body: Input changed. Recheck it, withdrawing old completion status and report access.

sections.heading: Verify Actual Operation and Programmatic Relationships
paragraphs: Accessibility concerns whether people with different abilities and support methods can perceive, understand and operate content. W3C’s keyboard explanation requires keyboard operation, with an exception for functions inherently dependent on movement paths. Filling, checking and exporting here are not freehand drawing and need keyboard paths. Visible focus identifies where the next keystroke acts.

Labels and controls need programmatic association; visual proximity cannot substitute. Color can reinforce meaning, but errors, completion and required fields must not rely on hue alone. These are separate aspects: tabbing through controls does not establish whole-page WCAG conformance.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Turn Design Promises into Pending Checks
rows: Labels
Purpose remains clear after entry; controls have identifiable names.
Inspect actual DOM/accessibility names; sketch placement is insufficient.
Keyboard and focus
Enter, check, correct and export without a mouse, knowing current focus.
Manual or browser operation; verify that controls can also be exited.
Errors and progress
Identify missing fields, retain values and recheck after correction.
Replay the case without claiming coverage of every error.
Non-color feedback
Text or other cues identify errors and completion.
Check meaning beyond color; verify assistive-technology semantics separately.
Dynamic status
Updates are perceivable appropriately without unjustified focus changes.
Test notifications and assistive technology in implementation; screenshots cannot establish this.

sections.heading: Use Replayable Tasks to Check Recovery
paragraphs: In your local prototype or the teacher environment, use the keyboard to enter application number and applicant code, leaving document type blank before checking. Observe field-specific feedback, retained input and correction access. After completing and rechecking, edit a field again and confirm that old completion cannot still be used.

The Streamlit reference supports practice, but this description is not its complete accessibility acceptance. Record browser, steps and observations for invisible focus, imperceptible feedback or unavailable actions. Without an implemented prototype, complete sketch review and leave actual keyboard/assistive-technology checks pending.

sections.heading: Separate Accessibility, Usability and Evidence of Passing
paragraphs: Accessibility and usability relate without replacing each other. Technical checks may pass while field meaning remains unclear. One successful peer task does not establish access for all users or assistive technologies. State the scope of automated checks, manual operation and actual participant observation separately.

A common mistake is assuming a help page resolves errors. Without field-specific feedback on the current screen, users still guess. Keep necessary feedback and recovery available at the task, with additional guidance as support. Connect confirmed behavior to M05 specifications and M08 verification.

blocks.heading: Recovery and Accessibility Observation Record
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records actual browser/version or pending status, correction/recheck/edit paths, observed retention, label/error association, reachable/operable/exitable/visible focus, non-color status, pending assistive-technology/participant work, barriers and retest conditions. It explicitly is not full WCAG certification; adapt it for class without inventing findings.

環境：填寫實際瀏覽器與版本；尚未執行則填待驗
路徑：缺件 → 補齊 → 重查 → 修改 → 再重查

欄位名稱／錯誤關聯：實際核對或待驗
鍵盤／焦點：可達、可操作、可離開、可見
狀態：文字能辨識，不只靠顏色

exercise.environment: Begin with four-state sketches. Use a browser and keyboard once your local prototype or a teacher demonstration is available; record no runtime results before starting it.
steps: Annotate separate feedback, progress retention and recovery for omissions, technical failure and stale results on the sketch.
If a prototype is available, set the mouse aside. Replay correction with Tab/Shift+Tab, text input and appropriate component keys, observing focus and ability to leave controls.
Record actual results or pending status in wireframe-notes.md. List assistive-technology tests, participant tasks and uncovered errors separately; select one barrier for revision and retesting.
exercise.expected: wireframe-notes.md with recovery design and honest distinctions among sketches, actual keyboard checks and pending items.
exercise.check: The three problems have different exits. Do not treat tabletop review without a prototype, one keyboard path or screenshots as complete accessibility certification.
exercise.cleanup: Use synthetic data only. Keep environment and replay steps; publish no unnecessary personal information or unauthorized recordings.

zh.prompt: 缺少文件類型時，哪種安排最能支援復原？
options: 只顯示紅色邊框
保留已填值，以文字指出缺少欄位、補填方法與重新檢查
清空全部欄位但不說原因
讓使用者下載仍標完整的舊報告
rationales: 缺少文字與動作，也只依賴顏色。
能定位、修正並繼續任務。
增加重填且沒有解釋。
過期或缺件資料不能沿用完整結果。

en.prompt: What best supports recovery when document type is missing?
options: A red border alone.
Retain entered values and identify the missing field, correction and rechecking in text.
Clear every field without explanation.
Allow the stale report still marked complete.
rationales: This lacks wording/action and relies only on color.
Users can locate, correct and continue the task.
This adds re-entry without explanation.
Stale or missing input cannot reuse a complete result.

zh.prompt: 鍵盤可以 Tab 到所有元件後，還應檢查什麼？
options: 只要能到就完全符合 WCAG
所有按鈕必須同時觸發
焦點可見、可操作、可離開、順序合理，其他可近用面向也需分別核對
把焦點框全部隱藏讓畫面乾淨
rationales: 可達只是一部分，不能代表整頁合規。
會造成未預期行為。
檢查涵蓋實際操作，也保留不同面向。
隱藏焦點會讓鍵盤使用者不知道目前位置。

en.prompt: After Tab reaches every control, what else needs checking?
options: Reachability alone fully satisfies WCAG.
Every button must trigger simultaneously.
Visible focus, operation, exits and sensible order, plus other accessibility aspects separately.
Hide all focus outlines for simplicity.
rationales: Reachability is only one aspect, not whole-page conformance.
That creates unexpected behavior.
This covers actual operation while retaining separate aspects.
Hidden focus leaves keyboard users uncertain of their location.

zh.prompt: 尚無可操作原型時，本章練習結果應如何記錄？
options: 全部標通過，因為草圖有文字
虛構瀏覽器與測試紀錄
宣稱螢幕閱讀器能理解圖片
完成草圖復原設計，實際鍵盤與輔助科技保持待驗
rationales: 草圖無法證明實際操作。
環境與結果需如實記錄。
圖片文字不會自動建立表單關聯。
把設計與實測分開，下一步驗證才可追溯。

en.prompt: No operable prototype exists yet. How should results be recorded?
options: Mark everything passed because the sketch has text.
Invent browser and test records.
Claim a screen reader understands the image.
Complete sketch recovery design while leaving actual keyboard and assistive-technology tests pending.
rationales: A sketch cannot establish operation.
Record environment and results honestly.
Image text does not automatically create form relationships.
Separating design from execution keeps later verification traceable.
